hooks.name: Validate asset manifest
hooks.description: When assets/manifest.json is saved, check every skin has all 8 poses, valid head anchors and all face patches, and that every referenced file exists.

action.prompt: assets/manifest.json was just saved. Validate it against the Manifest type in .kiro/specs/doodle-mirror/design.md: (1) every skin in `skins` has exactly the pose ids in `poseIds` (idle, wave, point, thumbs_up, hands_up, open_arms, facepalm, dab); (2) every pose has a `head` anchor with numeric x, y and size > 0, and the box (x ± size/2, y ± size/2) lies inside canvas.w x canvas.h; (3) every pose `face` is one of full, eyes-only, mouth-only, none; (4) every skin has eyes open/half/closed and mouths A/E/O/M/smile/laugh, each with a file and a rect with w,h > 0; (5) every referenced file exists under assets/. If src/assets/manifest.ts exists, also run its validator through the unit tests (npm test -- manifest). Report a short pass/fail list. Do not edit art files; only fix manifest typos if the fix is unambiguous, and say what you changed.
